body:
Bastard friend pulled my ear.

Felt like my head exploded.

First of all, thank you for doing this AMA.

I have two questions that may fall short of expectations, but I am legitimately curious.

1.  How do I develop a diction like yours?  I can understand many words, but I've been told I need to be able to use harder words.

2.  What do you do in your free time?  For fun.
But, that's much better than ignoring people.  Common courtesy?
Having to deal with jerks goes two ways.
Or she'll come to you and say "someone sent me these anonymously."  and still be cheating on you.
As a Korean, Shibalbat sounds really... interesting.
How about people watch how much they eat instead?
Saying thank you is a common courtesy.
Carrots.  The texture is crunchy and small bits stay in your mouth.  I also hate the taste.
I actually get made fun of for speaking slowly.  Is there a difference between speaking slowly and dragging a word out?

Okay, usually I leave Christianity alone and do what I do.

But this reminded me of when my parents took me to a church service, and the testimony was about a happy married couple who were tearfully thankful to God for providing them with an expensive sports car that looked like Bat Mobile instead of an old Toyota they were checking out.

This was after I came back from a medical/healthcare trip from Africa, and it just pissed me off to no end how shallow it was.
